The '''Imperial Third Fleet''' was a contingent of war [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] deployed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was defeated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Zale Barrows]], a privateer [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in command of the [[Free Spacers Fleet]], over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war.
